title: South Korean AI Star Solar Pro 4 Makes Its Debut, Directly Challenging Global Top-Level Models?
excerpt: Recently, the South Korean artificial intelligence laboratory Upstage officially launched a commercial large model called Solar Pro4, tailored for complex agent
content_html:
Recently, the South Korean artificial intelligence laboratory Upstage officially launched a commercial large model called Solar Pro4, tailored for complex agent tasks. This new model features a context window of up to 512K and supports an output length of up to 128K, allowing users to easily load and process multiple contracts, reports, and data files in a single session.

In terms of pricing, Solar Pro4 demonstrates highly competitive advantages. The input price per 1 million Tokens is $0.3, the cache read input price is $0.06, and the output price per 1 million Tokens is $1.2.

Focusing on performance for agent tasks, the model has been deeply optimized for real-world scenarios, with a particular emphasis on long documents, terminal tasks, and multi-turn tool calls. In official core tests, it scored 57 on Terminal-Bench v2.1, 23 on τ³-Banking, and 71 on AA-LCR. Upstage demonstrated this through a simulated task of analyzing store locations for a coffee brand: the model completed policy screening among 10 candidate sites using just three prompts and automatically generated three complete deliverables in sequence - an Excel workbook, a review report, and a presentation.

Currently, Solar Pro4 has fully debuted on several international authoritative AI model evaluation platforms. As the first model from a South Korean laboratory to appear on the Agent Arena, Code Arena: WebDev, and Text Arena rankings, it is ranked 44th on the Agent Arena list, matching the capabilities of well-known models such as MiniMax M2.7 and Nemotron3Ultra.

content_html_zh:
近日，韩国人工智能实验室Upstage正式推出了一款名为Solar Pro4的商用大型模型，专为复杂的智能体任务量身定制。 这一新模型具有高达 512K 的上下文窗口，并支持高达 128K 的输出长度，允许用户在单个会话中轻松加载和处理多个合同、报告和数据文件。

在定价方面，Solar Pro4展现出极具竞争优势。 每 100 万个 Token 的输入价格为 0.3 美元，缓存读取输入价格为 0.06 美元，每 100 万个 Token 的输出价格为 1.2 美元。

该模型以代理任务的性能为重点，针对现实场景进行了深度优化，特别强调长文档、终端任务和多轮工具调用。 在官方核心测试中，它在 Terminal-Bench v2.1 上得分为 57，在 τ³-Banking 上得分为 23，在 AA-LCR 上得分为 71。 Upstage 通过分析咖啡品牌商店位置的模拟任务证明了这一点：该模型仅使用三个提示就完成了 10 个候选站点的政策筛选，并按顺序自动生成了三个完整的交付成果：Excel 工作簿、审查报告和演示文稿。

目前，Solar Pro4已在多个国际权威AI模型评测平台全面首发。 作为首个出现在 Agent Arena、Code Arena: WebDev 和 Text Arena 排行榜上的韩国实验室模型，它在 Agent Arena 排行榜上排名第 44 位，与 MiniMax M2.7 和 Nemotron3Ultra 等知名模型的能力不相上下。
